commands/admin.md.layer_why: Opens the admin panel to inspect and rotate Brain API keys, a credential/registry management operation over the harness, not new methodology output.

commands/agentshield.md.layer_why: Scans the plugin's own MCP tools, hooks, skills, CLAUDE.md and dependencies for known attack patterns, a measurement pass over the harness itself.

commands/auto-explore.md.layer_why: Runs the same domain-decomposition cycle the PostToolUse hook fires automatically, a single agent cycle to a stopping condition, kind:utility only because it is hook-triggered rather than navigator-typed.

commands/brain-derive.md.layer_why: Rebuilds a room section's Brain-derived context on demand, changing what the model sees this turn without engineering new methodology.

commands/correct-reference-now.md.layer_why: Writes the true calendar date into the room's temporal reference, a session/context fact correction, not a methodology cycle or scaffolding change.

commands/dashboard.md.layer_why: Opens the live or snapshot De Stijl view; a render-only view of already-produced room state, the rubric's own literal none example.

commands/deck.md.layer_why: One governed flow (pick a shape, Feynman or HEART) that runs to completion and files a deck artifact, the same single-cycle shape as a methodology command, kind:mechanical only because it composes existing content rather than analyzing new content.

commands/doctor.md.layer_why: Diagnoses install-cache drift, ROOM.md gaps, statusline visibility and UI compliance; the canonical doctor-organ measurement and repair tool the rubric's own step 3 signal names by name.

commands/eureka.md.layer_why: Ranks cross-domain pairs into fundable-opportunity flags in one analysis cycle to a stopping condition, the same shape as a methodology command.

commands/explain-decision.md.layer_why: Shows the Navigation Engine trace for the last turn; a pure diagnostic render of a decision already made, not itself an engineering rung.

commands/explore-opportunity.md.layer_why: Explicitly runs the analysis chain (deep dive across multiple methodology steps) for a qualified opportunity -- a command that dispatches a chain, the rubric's own step 1 signal.

commands/export.md.layer_why: Packages an already-built room view as a shareable HTML artifact; a render/export of existing state, engineering no new rung.

commands/file-meeting.md.layer_why: Captures a transcript and files the resulting intelligence into room sections in one filing cycle to completion, the same shape as a methodology command that produces an artifact.

commands/funding.md.layer_why: Manages the grant/investor pipeline lifecycle (spotted to applied to decided) as a tracked registry, a harness-scaffolding operation.

commands/graph.md.layer_why: Translates a plain-English question into a graph traversal and displays the result; a read-only query/render view, not new engineering.

commands/heal.md.layer_why: Deprecated alias for /mos:doctor --heal-room; the underlying job is repairing structural drift, the rubric's own step 3 repair signal.

commands/help.md.layer_why: A command-family selector that dispatches the navigator to the right surface; routing/dispatch scaffolding, not new methodology or context.

commands/hmi-status.md.layer_why: Deprecated alias for /mos:doctor --ui-compliance; the underlying job is measuring UI Ruling System compliance, a doctor-organ measurement.

commands/ignite.md.layer_why: Walks three sequential birth gates (starting point, blueprint approve, first win), each an independent human-ratified checkpoint -- the rubric's own step 1 signal for halting at a material step for an independent reviewer, repeated three times.

commands/ingest-methodology.md.layer_why: Runs the maintainer's named 7-step pipeline (encode, Part-8 bound, and on) end to end, a multi-step coordinated flow over shared state.

commands/memory-cortex-reach.md.layer_why: Surfaces a stale governing thought or a fresh contradiction against a claim by reading the memory cortex, a harness-level memory measurement, the rubric's own step 3 memory_event signal.

commands/memory.md.layer_why: Shows the three memory layers (within-session, across-session, cross-room); a read-only diagnostic display of existing state.

commands/models.md.layer_why: Opens the routing profile and lets the navigator switch which model routes which kind of work; a configuration/registry toggle over the harness.

commands/mos.md.layer_why: Picks the right /mos:* surface to invoke when the navigator does not know which one to use; a routing/dispatch mechanism, the ICM Layer 1 routing job implemented as harness scaffolding.

commands/mva-brief.md.layer_why: Explicitly runs a 6-agent fan-out and deploys a shareable brief, the rubric's own step 1 fan-out signal by name.

commands/mva-option.md.layer_why: Routes the navigator's pick from the 3-option MVA footer into the correct next move; a dispatch mechanism, not new methodology output.

commands/mva-report.md.layer_why: Measures whether a prior conversation fired the right things at the right time and reports compliance, the same measurement job class as a doctor organ.

commands/new-project.md.layer_why: Creates room scaffolding and registers the new room in the room registry; the rubric's own step 3 signal names both "add scaffolding" and "a registry" verbatim.

commands/new-surface.md.layer_why: Emits a new command/agent/skill .md file with the correct connector descriptor; adding a tool to the harness, the rubric's own step 3 signal verbatim.

commands/onboard.md.layer_why: A single guided walkthrough cycle that builds the navigator's first room to a stopping condition, the same shape as a methodology command's cycle-to-artifact.

commands/operator.md.layer_why: Shows or sets how Larry should render this session (JUST_TALK, EXPLORE_CAPTURE, and so on); shapes the output style of subsequent turns, the rubric's own step 5 signal.

commands/opportunities.md.layer_why: Surfaces the Opportunity Bank registry with HSI scores and manages it as a live pipeline; a registry-management operation over the harness.

commands/organize.md.layer_why: Deprecated alias for /mos:rooms organize; the underlying job is managing the room portfolio hierarchy, a registry operation.

commands/present.md.layer_why: Generates and opens the 6-view presentation of an already-built room; a render-only view, engineering no new rung.

commands/publish.md.layer_why: Deploys the presentation to Vercel hosting infrastructure with a one-click link; wiring a real external tool, not merely rendering a view.

commands/pws-brain.md.layer_why: Runs the same methodology question against the experimental Aura Agent next to the production Brain and shows both; a diagnostic comparison view.

commands/qualify-opportunity.md.layer_why: Presents a single human-ratified decision gate over one harvested candidate and files the qualify/reject verdict, the same single-hitl-fork cycle shape as a methodology command.

commands/query.md.layer_why: Deprecated alias for /mos:graph; the underlying job is a read-only natural-language graph query and render.

commands/radar.md.layer_why: Tracks new Claude capabilities and displays them; a capability-awareness diagnostic view, engineering no rung.

commands/reanalyze.md.layer_why: Re-runs the cascade pattern detection cycle on an already-filed meeting to a stopping condition, the same shape as a methodology re-run.

commands/room.md.layer_why: Opens the room view with its current state; a render-only default entry-point view.

commands/rooms.md.layer_why: Manages the multi-room registry (switch, list, archive); a registry operation over the harness, the rubric's own step 3 signal verbatim.

commands/scheduled-tasks.md.layer_why: Defines a recurring Cowork job against the room, adding a scheduling mechanism to the harness.

commands/scout.md.layer_why: Fires the sentinel background checks proactively across the room, a measurement/scanning mechanism over the harness, the same job class as a doctor organ.

commands/setup.md.layer_why: Walks through wiring optional integrations (Brain, Velma); a configuration/tool-wiring operation over the harness.

commands/show.md.layer_why: Asks the navigator's job in plain language and routes to the matching view command; a dispatch mechanism, the same routing job class as /mos:mos and /mos:help.

commands/skill.md.layer_why: Projects a confirmed SyntheticExpert persona into the conversation; shapes the voice/persona of subsequent requests, the rubric's own step 5 signal verbatim.

commands/snapshot.md.layer_why: Packages the Data Room into a portable frozen bundle for sharing; a render/export of existing content, engineering no new rung.

commands/speakers.md.layer_why: Shows a filed meeting's participants, roles and attendance; a read-only diagnostic display.

commands/splash.md.layer_why: Displays the decorative MindrianOS Mondrian banner; engineers no rung at all, the rubric's own literal none case.

commands/stance.md.layer_why: Shifts how Larry talks this session (pull evidence, decisive, Socratic, challenge); shapes voice and wording of subsequent requests, the rubric's own step 5 signal verbatim.

commands/status.md.layer_why: Shows the governing thought per section plus health glyphs for a fast read; a read-only diagnostic display.

commands/update.md.layer_why: Checks for and installs a newer plugin version via the native plugin loader; an install-cache/tooling maintenance operation over the harness.

commands/vault.md.layer_why: Exports the Data Room as a nested Obsidian vault for offline reading; a render/export of existing content.

commands/visualize.md.layer_why: Deprecated alias for /mos:dashboard --mermaid; the underlying job is a render-only knowledge-graph view.

commands/wiki.md.layer_why: Opens the Data Room as linked wiki pages; a render-only view of already-filed content.
